checks: 18 selected tests twice debug/twice release; seven compiled mutants and restored positives
cost: Repeated has/vars scans and dedup, subtree cloning and simplify can be quadratic or output-size dominated, without AST budget. Numerical check uses up to24 evaluations plus cloned envs: O(8*(cost(f)+cost(df)+env size)), with delegated arithmetic and recursion.
description: simplify recursively folds Q constants/identities including0*x and0/x, with constant power |k|<=64. derive returns0 first if target absent; otherwise applies arithmetic and supported unary chain rules, appends steps and simplifies. Supported calls sin/cos/tan/exp/ln/log/sqrt/asin/acos/atan. check_derivative samples eight fixed points, central difference h=1e-5 max(|p|,1), skips unsupported/nonfinite samples and accepts >=3 usable points with each normalized discrepancy<=1e-5 against max(|df|,1).

inverse: Derivative g admits all supported source trees whose rule expansion simplifies to g. On connected valid domains antiderivatives already differ by additive constants; syntax simplification expands fibers. Unknown target-free calls also map0. Numeric Check constrains only sampled neighborhoods, not a unique antecedent or global identity; steps are partial rule traces, not reversible serialization.
